# STLElement

**Class:** `UltraCanvasSTLElement` · **Group:** [Text, images and media](../Groups/Text-images-and-media.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/Plugins/Models/STL/UltraCanvasSTLElement.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/Plugins/Models/STL/UltraCanvasSTLElement.h) · `#include "Models/STL/UltraCanvasSTLElement.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasGLSurface`](UltraCanvasGLSurface.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

A 3D mesh from an `.stl` file — shaded, orbited with the mouse (with or without GL)

## Creating it

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasSTLElement(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float width, float height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Callbacks

Assign a lambda to the member (or call the setter). Capture the element and its parents **raw**, never as a `shared_ptr` - see [Events and callbacks](../Events-and-Callbacks.md#ownership).

| Callback | Signature | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `onLoadError` | `std::function<void(const std::string&)> onLoadError` | Notifications. |
| `onLoadComplete` | `std::function<void()> onLoadComplete` | _Load complete_ |

**Inherited callbacks:**

- from [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md): `eventCallback`, `onPopupAboutToClose`, `onPopupClosed`, `onPopupOpened`, `SetEventCallback`
